paragraphs.text:
Having come so far, having seen death and danger, you know 
that the fate of the world could very well depend on you. How 
could you fail but to try to steal the Karpathos Device and stop 
it getting into the wrong hands? 
• If you want to attempt the theft now, go to 229. 
• If you want to hide until the doors close and then steal it, go 
to 281. 
• Or, if you think better of it, you can return to 206.
(209)
